entries.title: Psalms 140:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> O Lord, take me out of the power of the evil man; keep me safe from the violent man:

entries.title: Psalms 140:2
segments: For their hearts are full of evil designs; and they are ever making ready causes of war.

entries.title: Psalms 140:3
segments: Their tongues are sharp like the tongue of a snake; the poison of snakes is under their lips. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 140:4
segments: O Lord, take me out of the hands of sinners; keep me safe from the violent man: for they are designing my downfall.

entries.title: Psalms 140:5
segments: The men of pride have put secret cords for my feet; stretching nets in my way, so that they may take me with their tricks. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 140:6
segments: I have said to the Lord, You are my God: give ear, O Lord, to the voice of my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 140:7
segments: O Lord God, the strength of my salvation, you have been a cover over my head in the day of the fight.

entries.title: Psalms 140:8
segments: ¶O Lord, give not the wrongdoer his desire; give him no help in his evil designs, or he may be uplifted in pride. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 140:9
segments: As for those who come round me, let their heads be covered by the evil of their lips.

entries.title: Psalms 140:10
segments: Let burning flames come down on them: let them be put into the fire, and into deep waters, so that they may not get up again.

entries.title: Psalms 140:11
segments: Let not a man of evil tongue be safe on earth: let destruction overtake the violent man with blow on blow.

entries.title: Psalms 140:12
segments: I am certain that the Lord will take care of the cause of the poor, and of the rights of those who are troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 140:13
segments: Truly, the upright will give praise to your name: the holy will have a place in your house.
